items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s when I brought in Gabor and Stinson and Garnett Brown... We were both from Memphis... So I brought Garnett in... But then we just did it with Stinson and Gabor and myself with Chico.

ctx.x: That’s when I brought in Gabor and Stinson and Garnett Brown whom I had gone to high school with in Memphis. We were both from Memphis, he was a trombone player. Cause Chico wanted a trombone, I said, “Ok, I know a guy.” So I brought Garnett in. And Garnett was a great musician, but our conceptions were a little shaky at a certain
point. So George Bohanon was more fluid and more rubato. Garnett was more [Imitates Garnett’s playing of Mozart’s Eine Kleine Nachtmusick Movt. 1].
